required_fixes: Add an explicit mapping of disclosed metrics/targets to the climate-related (and other sustainability-related, if applicable) risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect prospects, indicating which metrics are required by IFRS S2 (and any other applicable IFRS SDS) versus entity-defined metrics (IFRS S1.46).

Improve labelling/definitions: specify units for all baselines/targets (eg 'All-scopes target' baseline), clarify duplicated internal carbon price 'Investment decisions' rows, and explain what each listed equity row represents (IFRS S1.53).
Provide comparative information for preceding period(s) for all disclosed amounts, or explicitly state impracticability where applicable (IFRS S1.B49, B53, B54).

Address the Scope 1 'correction' under the comparative revision requirements: disclose revised comparative amounts (if prior-period figures were affected), quantify differences, and explain reasons; or clarify that no prior-period amounts were affected (IFRS S1.B50/B52).

State GHG measurement standard used (GHG Protocol Corporate Standard 2004 or jurisdictional alternative) and provide a coherent description of measurement approach, key inputs/assumptions, reasons for choices, and changes during the period (IFRS S2.29(a)(ii)–(iii)).

Provide required Scope 1/2 disaggregation between consolidated accounting group and other investees (associates/JVs/unconsolidated subsidiaries/other investees), or explicitly state that there are none (IFRS S2.29(a)(iv)).
For Scope 3, list the categories included in the Scope 3 measure and clarify which categories are excluded/not measured (IFRS S2.29(a)(vi)(1)).
If any targets were revised, disclose revisions and explanations; if none, consider stating 'no revisions during 2024' to avoid ambiguity (IFRS S1.51(g)).
